children.text: Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data to load your Home.
Your next vibe is worth reconnecting for.
We can’t refresh videos or creator recommendations without a connection.
Mobile playback uses your carrier’s data plan. Check your connection before continuing.
Discovery and video previews may take longer to load.
On MTN or Orange, normal carrier data charges still apply. Try a stronger signal or Wi-Fi.
We couldn’t find a match for “Waterside orchestra”. Try a shorter search, a creator’s name or a different category.
Something unexpected stopped Home from loading. Your account and original files haven’t been changed by this screen.
Try the request again. If it keeps happening, use the available help options.
Your current account role doesn’t have permission to upload or manage creator videos.
You’re signed in as a viewer
You can browse, follow creators and watch original stories. Start creator onboarding to learn about publishing access.
Onboarding does not guarantee creator permissions.
Your sign-in session is no longer valid. Sign in again to continue to Creator Studio.
After signing in, we’ll return you to the requested area if your account still has access. Any interrupted upload must be checked separately.
Your password is never displayed on this screen.
The stage is quiet for a moment.
KoloVibe’s service can’t be reached right now. This may be temporary; your device may still have internet access.
Try again later. Avoid repeatedly submitting uploads or account requests while the service is unavailable.
We’ll show service information when it becomes available.
The service has temporarily limited this action. Wait for the retry guidance returned by the service before trying again.
No retry time was provided. There’s no countdown to follow here.
Your next story is on your device.
Select a video you own or have permission to share.
Device permission is requested when you select media. No upload begins just by granting access.
KoloVibe can’t open your selected media with the current permission. You can review access in your device settings.
We need access only to select a video for your upload. Where your device supports it, choose selected media rather than your entire library.
Original stories from Monrovia. Finding the extraordinary in everyday life.
You’ve edited your creator bio. Save before leaving, or discard these unsaved changes.
